title: Visits Covered by a Single Specialist Referral (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Referral computation sheet — single specialist referrals, Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

**Clause.** A single referral covers the standard referral visits of **4 visits**. The visits covered never exceed the practice type's single-referral visit ceiling.

**As a definition.** The visits a single specialist referral records are the standard referral visits, or the single-referral visit ceiling of the member's practice type where that ceiling is lower. Every figure is a whole number of visits.

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Standard referral visits | 4 |
| Ceiling | The single-referral visit ceiling of the practice type of the member's active assignment |
| Order | The ceiling is applied last, to the visit figure |

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)**

- Practice type with a single-referral visit ceiling of 6: 4 is within 6, so the referral records **4** visits.
- Practice type with a single-referral visit ceiling of 12: 4 is within 12, so the referral records **4** visits.
- A hypothetical ceiling of 3, used only to show the ceiling at work: 4 exceeds 3, so the referral would record **3** visits.
